acc: Where a board source (AnKing card, UWorld, NBME) and a guideline differ, the brief teaches the board answer and puts the guideline in an "In practice:" hover (runbook section 3): the hover is intended, not a finding.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule: nothing is cut for length).
Lookups (hiv-vax, bs-isolation) have no stepper: steps 1 to 8 absent is not a finding.
L facts (the old brief's own lines) are a valid source for carried content. via=relayed facts were read by the lead with WebFetch where fetch.py was refused (cdc.gov); judge the quote as given.

Lead calls (judge accuracy, not the choice): tb teaches BCG plus a positive PPD as infection, ethambutol red-green color loss, and 10 mm in chronic kidney disease (board), with MSD's blue-green and dialysis 5 mm in In practice hovers; tb latent regimens 3HP or 4R both first line, 9H only if neither, ART started within 2 weeks; hiv-vax MMR at CD4 200 or higher (board) with the 15% for 6 months rule in a hover; bs-foodborne nontyphoidal Salmonella antibiotics under 1 year (card 1704930797526) with MSD in a hover; cervicitis test of cure in pregnancy teaches the card's two weeks with CDC's 3 to 4 weeks in a hover; bs-isolation teaches RSV as contact (UWorld outranks the AnKing droplet listing, Jonathan 2026-10-10).

Carried with the unverified mark because board-tested and no source opened today states it (judge its Step 2 accuracy, not the marking): none open; rmsf abdominal pain was sourced by a relayed CDC reading ("severe" dropped).

Check these specifically (lead S3 notes): rmsf "most patients have one only by the sixth day of fever": the wording and its quote (CDC gives rash onset typically 2 to 4 days after fever); hiv-vax recombinant zoster at CD4 90 keyed "give now" (q_3c8aaa714f47): check against the cited source (some HIV guidance defers until ART suppression or CD4 200); bs-isolation TB release "3 negative smears over 2 days, at least 1 from early morning": check the quote's interval; cervicitis inpatient regimen "continued until she has been afebrile for 24 hours": check against the quote (CDC words the oral switch as after clinical improvement); bs-anaphylaxis PSGN option C wording rests on a relayed StatPearls reading.

Not to report (Jonathan's calls, in the report): rmsf scope (one brief for tick-borne illness, no split); bs-foodborne scope (13 organisms, no other owner); hiv-vax Tdap 27 to 36 weeks against the card's third trimester (preg-vax owns timing).
